According to the NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture schematic in `02_Zero_Trust_Architecture_Specs.pdf` (`ZTA-NIST-800-207`):
1. **Control Plane Assessment (`PE -> PA`)**: The **Policy Engine (PE)** continuously evaluates device posture, BeyondCorp context-aware access levels, and Google SecOps (Chronicle) threat intelligence feeds. 2. **Data Plane Gatekeeping (`PEP`)**: The **Policy Enforcement Point (PEP)**—implemented via BeyondCorp Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) and Envoy mTLS service mesh ingress gateways—terminates all untrusted traffic and grants per-request access to the **Protected Enterprise Enclave** only when authorized by the PA, streaming every allow/deny decision to Chronicle SIEM.
